scope: Lane C8 (2026-09-19 estate MCP/TUI/skills audit, read-only): toolchain repo C:/Users/Prekzursil/source/agent-skills-toolchain (branch feat/tool-registry-governance @ 3c9cece7f, incl. platform/ layout and .agents/ mirror) vs live C:/Users/Prekzursil/.agents (harness-at-root layout, git branch live-capture/2026-09-02 @ ce1d6048). Map what syncs where; find orphaned either-side artifacts. Probes: python os.listdir set-diffs, git (ls-files/status/log/ls-remote/worktree list, read-only), PowerShell Get-Item LinkType, jq, file sha256, direct Reads.

findings.item: Estate rule 'live ~/.agents keeps harness-at-root layout (agents.json + scripts + skills at root)'
findings.evidence: Live root listing (142 entries): agents.json, scripts/, skills/, commands/, harness/, rules/ at root. No repo-root-layout artifacts (no package.json, .github, ci/, node_modules) at live root. Detector control: same listing surfaced known-present agents.json/scripts/skills, so the absence reads are trustworthy.

findings.item: Estate rule 'never check out the repo's platform layout into the live folder'
findings.evidence: No platform/ subtree at live root (142-entry listing). Repo platform/ (14 entries: registry, routing, schema, plugin, lib, corpus, council, cyberstrike, marketplace, architecture, coordination, workflows + 2 DEFECT md) exists only in the repo. The live checkout's branch tree is the harness-at-root layout, not platform/.
findings.recommendation: None. The one-command-away risk is captured in the git-checkout finding below.

findings.item: Live ~/.agents is a full git clone of the toolchain remote (live-capture flow) — one wrong checkout breaks load paths
findings.evidence: C:/Users/Prekzursil/.agents/.git/config: remote origin = https://github.com/Prekzursil/agent-skills-toolchain.git; HEAD = refs/heads/live-capture/2026-09-02; branch tracks origin. Capture rail proven end-to-end today: live HEAD ce1d60489cd4542443e986e0f01c95974889dd04 == git ls-remote origin tip (opusclip-shorts commits 2026-09-19). Risk: any 'git checkout main' / 'git pull' run in live would materialize repo-root layout (package.json, .github, ci/, platform/, node_modules path) into ~/.agents, breaking load paths — exactly what the estate rule guards. Also contradicts the 2026-07-11 memory ('Edit ~/.agents in-place, NOT git').
findings.recommendation: Keep live-capture/2026-09-02 as the only branch ever checked out in live; add a cheap guard (e.g. a PATH-anchored README + a pre-checkout hook, or 'git config remote.origin.fetch' narrowed to the live-capture ref) so a routine pull in live cannot fetch/checkout repo-root-layout branches.

Canonical checkout's origin/live-capture remote-tracking ref is fetch-stale at 726687ecf (2026-09-02) while remote tip is ce1d6048 (2026-09-19).

summary: Layout rule HELD: live ~/.agents is genuine harness-at-root (agents.json/scripts/skills at root), no platform/ checkout, and the junction chain .claude/skills -> skills.daily -> .agents/skills is intact (PowerShell LinkType), giving exact 383/383 vault parity. The structural surprise: live ~/.agents is itself a git clone of the toolchain repo on branch live-capture/2026-09-02, actively capturing live state (HEAD == GitHub remote tip ce1d6048 today; 133 dirty files = today's uncaptured harness/agents.json edits) — deliberate, but one 'git pull/checkout main' in live would materialize repo-root layout and break load paths; guard it. Main drift: the repo's .agents/ mirror is 12 days stale (agents.json 52,670B/09-07 vs 62,603B/09-19, sha 27e8d64c vs 2904eb1f) while the fresh truth lives on the live-capture branch the canonical checkout has not fetched since 09-02. Orphans: 6-7 live-only skills never captured to repo (opusclip-shorts excepted — captured today), 5 stale toolchain dupes (2 registered worktrees, 2 unregistered dirs, 1 full clone), plus live-root cruft (15 vm_*.ps1, 7 agents.json.bak, committed bak-frida-codex) and repo-root debris incl. an ignored-but-sensitive mitm_mcp_traffic.db. Secrets hygiene clean: local.json/secrets/*.key/*.pem untracked; browser-profiles tracked only by documented owner exception.
